existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: `RiskAssessment` has one direct R4-to-R6 instance break: `reasonCode` and `reasonReference` are replaced by `reason`. The main migration concerns are reason transformation, new Observation Status codes, and R6-only `performer`/`probabilityQuantity` content. Confidence is high for structural changes and medium for exact downgrade policies because official ConceptMaps and narrative change notes were not supplied.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Migration should treat `RiskAssessment.reason` as the required structural transform. R4 `reasonCode` values map naturally to `reason.concept`, and R4 `reasonReference` values map naturally to `reason.reference`. Downgrade from R6 to R4 needs policy for `CodeableReference` repetitions containing both concept and reference, new status codes, Patient/RelatedPerson performers, and percent Quantity probabilities.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high for element presence, cardinality, type, reference target, and binding changes because both StructureDefinitions were present and directly compared. Confidence is lower for terminology semantics and best downgrade mappings because no official expansions, ConceptMaps, or ballot rationale were included.
